blocks.label: TRIGGER
blocks.desc: Starts the loop: schedule, file change, issue opened, CI failure, manual. Something has to ask.

blocks.label: CONTEXT
blocks.desc: What the agent gets to see this iteration. Not everything. Everything is how you die.

blocks.label: AGENT STEP
blocks.desc: The model acts. It is confident. Confidence is not a metric.

blocks.label: TOOL
blocks.desc: read / write / tests / build / browse / shell. Today: run tests. They do not care how the code feels.

blocks.label: OBSERVE
blocks.desc: Capture what the tool said, put it back in context. An unread test is a ritual, not a signal.

blocks.label: VERIFIER
blocks.desc: Machine-checkable pass/fail. The whole point. It cannot be flattered.

blocks.label: VERIFIER
blocks.desc: A vibe with a socket. Accepts compliments. Returns opinions.

blocks.label: STOP: SUCCESS
blocks.desc: Leave when the verifier says pass. A loop with no exit is called a career.

blocks.label: STOP: CAP
blocks.desc: A maximum number of tries. Hope is not a maximum.

blocks.label: STOP: BUDGET
blocks.desc: A spending limit. The invoice arrives either way; this decides the font size.

blocks.label: HUMAN GATE
blocks.desc: Pause for a person. Powerful in one place. In every place, the person is the loop.

blocks.label: ESCALATE
blocks.desc: Give up loudly instead of quietly. A failure that files a report is worth something.

guided.hint: Two sockets are cold. The loop knows what it is missing. Soon, so will you.

socketHints.observe: An empty socket after TOOL. The tests will say things. Someone should listen.
socketHints.stop_cap: An empty socket among the stops. How many tries is too many? Pick a number.

ridge.intro: The bridge is missing one plank. The gap is shaped exactly like a verifier.
ridge.retreatDenied: There is no way back. The trail behind you has been deprecated.
crossSuccess: The plank fits. Machine-checked. The bridge holds because holding is testable.
The party crosses while the loop runs on. Nobody watches. That was the point.
ridge.crossGated: You crossed. You personally inspected every plank. It took eleven days.
ridge.banked: +40 UNATTENDED MILES. THE PARTY SLEPT. THE LOOP DID NOT.

tutorial.prompt: You are a world-class principal staff senior engineer. Think step by step. Be correct. Do not be incorrect. My career depends on this. (revision 41, framed)
fires: PROMPT fired. 62% of the task appears, fully formed, in one pass.
It is genuinely impressive. The remaining 38% is load-bearing.
The same missing part is missing, with better formatting.
The prompt is now longer than the task.
tutorial.ceremony: Fort Prompt records this as its best result in two years. There is a ceremony.
tutorial.loopIntro: A settler whispers: some parties wire the output back into the input.
loopLines: ITER 1 - act, observe: 74%. The loop found the missing part by looking.
ITER 2 - act, observe: 83%. No inspiration was involved.
ITER 3 - act, observe: 91%. The prompt has not changed once.
ITER 4 - act, observe: 97%. The fort has gone quiet.
ITER 5 - act, observe: 100%. Done. Verified. Boring.
tutorial.banner: A PROMPT IS A WISH. A LOOP IS A PROCESS.
tutorial.moral: The loop did not need to be inspired. It needed to be told when it was wrong.

run.start: PANEL ENERGIZED. Current on the line.

visitLines.trigger: TRIGGER - issue #4198: 'button does nothing (the main button)'.
visitLines.context: CONTEXT - the failing test, the file, the conventions doc. Nothing else.
visitLines.agent: AGENT - reads, edits src/button.ts. Confidence: unearned, pending.
visitLines.human_gate: GATE - waiting for a human. The human is in a meeting about this loop.

success.banner: THE LOOP RAN UNATTENDED. THE PARTY SLEPT.
lines: ITER 1 - edit, test: 3 failing. OBSERVE: noted. Adjusting.
ITER 2 - edit, test: 1 failing. OBSERVE: closer. The output steers.
ITER 3 - edit, test: 0 failing. VERIFIER: pass. It cannot be flattered.
STOP: SUCCESS - the loop exits on purpose. Under cap. Under budget.
success.gateLine: GATE - a human approved iteration {n}. The human added nothing, warmly.

no_verifier.banner: YOU HAVE DIED OF UNEARNED CONFIDENCE.
lines: The agent declares victory. Nothing was asked to disagree.
Production reports the feature does not exist.
The tests were never run. The checkmarks were real, though.

subjective_verifier.banner: THE LOOP NEVER TERMINATED. IT LOOKED GOOD THE WHOLE TIME.
lines: VERIFIER - does it look good? Define look. Define good.
VERIFIER - good relative to what? The requirements also merely look good.
VERIFIER - consider the ship of Theseus, if every plank were a refactor.
VERIFIER - what is 'done'? A social construct with a deadline.
VERIFIER - it looks the way the sea looks. Deep. Unknowable. Wet.
VERIFIER - requesting additional tokens to continue looking.
subjective_verifier.drain: Tokens draining. The verifier has opened a second line of inquiry.

no_stop_cap.banner: NOTHING TOLD IT TO STOP. NOTHING WILL.
no_stop_cap.iterLine: ITER {n} - fix applied. tests failing. trying again.
iterVariants: ITER {n} - a bold new approach: the previous approach.
ITER {n} - renamed a variable. hope levels: unchanged.
ITER {n} - the fix now has a fix. they disagree.
no_stop_cap.watch: The party watches the screen fill. The party says nothing.
escalated: ESCALATE fired at ITER 6: 'I QUIT, AND HERE IS WHY', it wrote, correctly.
The report is attached. Loud failure. Cheap, as failures go.
lines: The loop is still running somewhere. It sends its regards.

no_stop_budget.banner: THE WORK IS DONE. SO ARE YOU.
lines: ITER 1 - edit, test: 2 failing. Retrying, expensively.
ITER 2 - test: pass. VERIFIER: pass. Each step retried 40 times, to be sure.
STOP: SUCCESS - the loop exits. Something arrives with the sunrise.
no_stop_budget.after: The bill was always coming. The cap decides whether you meet it standing.

no_observe.banner: IT FIXED THE WRONG FILE. TWICE.
lines: TOOL - npm test: 14 failing.
AGENT - output unread. Diagnosis anyway: probably utils.ts. Editing utils.ts.
TOOL - npm test: 14 failing. Identically.
AGENT - output unread. Bold new theory: utils.ts, but more so.
TOOL - npm test: 14 failing. The failures have formed a union.
The answer was in the output. The output was never in the context.

human_gate_everywhere.banner: IT WORKED. IT TOOK ELEVEN DAYS. YOU ARE THE BOTTLENECK.
lines: GATE - waiting for a human. (day 1)
GATE - approved: 'lgtm'. Next gate in forty minutes. (day 2)
GATE - waiting. Your calendar has opinions. (day 4)
GATE - approved from an airport. (day 6)
GATE - waiting. The human is at an offsite about velocity. (day 9)
VERIFIER - pass. STOP: SUCCESS. (day 11)
Every step was safe. Every step was you. You stood in the loop you built.

missing.trigger: No TRIGGER seated: nothing asks, so nothing answers.
missing.context: No CONTEXT seated: the agent would act on a clean conscience and an empty head.
missing.agent: No AGENT STEP seated: a loop of pure administration. The org has plenty.
missing.tool_tests: No TOOL seated: the agent can only describe what it would have done.
missing.stop_success: No STOP: SUCCESS seated: even a perfect pass would just keep going.
